prompt:
Reference image 1 is a STYLE reference (art from the game Card Survival: Fantasy Forest, the picture the game uses for a caught bird): match its ink linework, flat shading and palette, and its plain, matter-of-fact way of drawing a bird as a game item. Do not copy the partridge itself.
Subject: a pale great horned owl lying flat on its side on the ground, its body horizontal across the picture, about twice as long as it is tall: head at the left end resting on the ground, small ear tufts lying flat, cream and pale grey-brown barred plumage, tail at the right end; both wings folded tight against its body and bound with three plain turns of rough brown cord round its middle; one yellow-scaled leg with dark talons stretched out behind, caught in a tight cord snare loop whose cord trails off a short way; beak closed, eye half open with a dull, blank look, feathers lying neat and smooth. A plain, unsentimental picture of a snared bird, nothing comic or cute.
Style: the look of the game Card Survival: Fantasy Forest, flat posterized colour fills in a few tonal steps, thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch marks, a continuous dark outline around the whole bird, a muted naturalistic palette, realistic proportions; not watercolour, not cartoon.
Single subject, centred, filling most of the frame with a white margin on every side, isolated on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) that fills every edge of the frame, no ground shadow, no scenery, no surface. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: standing, sitting upright, perched, facing the viewer, an expression, glaring eyes, wide round staring eyes, an open beak, hissing, ruffled feathers, a comical or cute pose, cartoon, a wooden peg, a stake, blood, wounds, a partridge, more than one bird, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, watercolour bleed, paper texture, soft airbrush gradients, neon colours, cropped, blurry, grey background, off-white background, gradient background, checkerboard, transparency grid, scenery behind the subject, drop shadow, text, watermark, signature, border, frame, footprints, tracks.
